caption: The drawing features a collection of stylized, outline figures and shapes on a textured dark gray-blue background. The largest figure is in the lower right quadrant and resembles a lizard or reptile, outlined in yellow and white, with four legs splayed and a circular pattern near its head. Above this figure is a long, segmented, worm-like shape in white and red. Scattered throughout are more reptilian or human-like shapes, some outlined in yellow, red, black, or white, varying in size and orientation. Toward the upper left, there is a sectioned area with several upright, simple humanoid figures, some connected by a zigzag black and yellow line. At the bottom left, an inset contains a single red-outlined, humanoid figure with prominent ears and hands. Other details include small, grouped humanoid forms, and several abstract patterns, such as a concentric circular motif in the center, and clusters of dots and lines near the bottom. The overall composition consists of clearly separated, flatly colored objects set against a pointillist-style background.
title: Petroglyph
